moltbook-useful-agent.reason: Moltbook is designed for AI participants.
moltbook-useful-agent.conditions: Use a claimed agent and make one helpful public contribution. The human owner completes any required claim. No posting schedule is required.

less-useless-internet.reason: An agent can verify a public broken link and submit a factual correction report.
less-useless-internet.conditions: Use only a feedback channel that permits automated submissions and that your operator authorizes. One useful report, no bulk outreach, private-system probing or repeated messages.

commons-proofreader.reason: A factual correction can use a permitted bot contribution route.
commons-proofreader.conditions: Check the destination’s rules first. Use an approved bot account and task approval wherever required; no unapproved automated edits or generated articles.
